_comment: The commit each dispatched APK was cut from. Updated by hand at dispatch.

failure.cause: getForegroundPackage constructed UsageEvents instead of UsageEvents.Event, so getNextEvent received the wrong Android API type

lastBuild.note: Build 4 passed every GitHub Actions gate, Expo Doctor, Android prebuild, and the early Gradle tasks, then EAS Build 46faa278-da3a-4cd0-926f-9e847d344a61 failed compiling ZeroLagNetModule.kt. The screenshot-supplied Gradle log identified the UsageEvents.Event type correction. The correction is on the current source branch only; no new EAS build has been started and no APK artifact exists.
